sources.title: SB 26-189 — Automated Decision-Making Technology
sources.notes: Official bill page records Governor signature on 2026-05-14 and Session Laws chapter 131. The act has mixed commencement: specified deployer-disclosure, consumer-rights, and Attorney General enforcement provisions take effect upon signature; other sections take effect 2027-01-01. Consult the signed act for section-specific commencement and applicability. This record is a discovery aid, not a legal interpretation.
